proposals.before: He was appointed assistant in the Minzhong guard office.
proposals.after: He was appointed sheriff of Minzhong.
proposals.reason: 閩中尉 is the county lieutenant/sheriff of Minzhong, not an assistant in a 'guard office'.

proposals.before: He was assigned as assistant in the Minzhong guard office.
proposals.after: He was assigned as sheriff of Minzhong.
proposals.reason: 尉 here is the county sheriff (xianwei), not a guard-office assistant.

proposals.before: Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lili circuit, heard of his ability and put him in charge of the grain-purchase stations.
proposals.after: Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lizhou circuit, heard of his ability and put him in charge of the grain-purchase stations.
proposals.reason: 利路 is the Lizhou circuit (利州路), not 'Lili'.

proposals.before: Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lili circuit, hearing of his worth, had him oversee the grain-purchase stations.
proposals.after: Cao Yanyue, transport commissioner of the Lizhou circuit, hearing of his worth, had him oversee the grain-purchase stations.
proposals.reason: 利路 abbreviates 利州路 (Lizhou circuit).

proposals.before: Soon he held Hanzhou in temporary authority; by precedent compared with acting officials, stipends and gifts were all as for the real post; Changyi ordered them cut in half.
proposals.after: Soon he held Hanzhou in temporary authority; by precedent, acting officials received stipends and gifts equal to those of regular appointees; Changyi ordered them cut in half.
proposals.reason: 故事比攝官，奉饋皆如真 is the same precedent as the idiomatic rendering, not a comparison 'with' acting officials as a separate class.

proposals.before: He wrapped his bedding with high resolve and set out through the pass. Suddenly he fell ill, and on the road his condition grew grave. When the emperor heard of it, he appointed him Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion and transferred him to Jiaxing prefecture.
proposals.after: He wrapped his bedding with high resolve and set out through the pass. Suddenly he fell ill, and on the road his condition grew grave. When the emperor heard of it, he appointed him compiler of the Secret Pavilion and transferred him to Jiaxing prefecture.
proposals.reason: 秘閣修撰 is compiler of the Secret Pavilion (Migge), not a Hanlin (翰林) appointment.

proposals.before: With generous spirit he wrapped his bedding and left the pass; suddenly he fell ill; on the road his illness grew severe; the emperor heard of it and appointed him Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion, changing him to Jiaxing prefecture.
proposals.after: With generous spirit he wrapped his bedding and left the pass; suddenly he fell ill; on the road his illness grew severe; the emperor heard of it and appointed him compiler of the Secret Pavilion, changing him to Jiaxing prefecture.
proposals.reason: Hanlin is not in the Chinese; 秘閣修撰 should not be rendered as a Hanlin post.

proposals.before: His father Yihe had served as investigating censor in charge of the You Shen Observatory.
proposals.after: His father Yihe had served as attendant censor assigned to manage Youshen Abbey.
proposals.reason: 侍御史 is attendant censor, not investigating censor; 佑神觀 is a Daoist abbey sinecure, not an observatory.

proposals.before: His father Yihe was investigating censor in charge of the You Shen Observatory.
proposals.after: His father Yihe was attendant censor assigned to manage Youshen Abbey.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 侍御史 and of 觀 as observatory.

proposals.before: He next served as magistrate of Taiping County and was assigned to handle documents for the Two-Zhe transport office, but before he could take up the latter post he mourned a close relative and was promoted to supervise the Western Treasury of the Left Storehouse at the capital.
proposals.after: He next served as magistrate of Taiping County and was assigned to handle documents for the Two-Zhe transport office, but before he could take up the latter post he went into mourning for his mother and was promoted to supervise the Western Treasury of the Left Storehouse at the capital.
proposals.reason: 內艱 specifically denotes mourning for one's mother rather than an unspecified close relative.

proposals.before: Wang Gang, styled Zhongju, was a native of Yixian County and the great-grandson of Bo, who had held the post of document signer at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
proposals.after: Wang Gang, styled Zhongju, was a native of Yixian County and the great-grandson of Bo, who had been signatory official of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
proposals.reason: 簽書樞密院 names the office of signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, not a person who signed documents.

proposals.before: He reported illness and asked to retire. He was appointed Hanlin compiler in the Secretariat Pavilion and prefect of Wuzhou, then judicial intendant of Eastern Zhejiang. He declined each post repeatedly but was not permitted to withdraw.
proposals.after: He reported illness and asked to retire. He was appointed Auxiliary Academician of the Palace Library and prefect of Wuzhou, then judicial intendant of Eastern Zhejiang. He declined each post repeatedly but was not permitted to withdraw.
proposals.reason: 直秘閣 names the Palace Library posting; rendering it as a Hanlin compiler invents an office the Chinese does not use.

proposals.before: If one can jointly admonish inside and outside and unify correction of discipline, if heaven still does not rain, your subject requests to submit to the crime of lying face down in noodles.
proposals.after: If one can jointly admonish inside and outside and unify correction of discipline, if heaven still does not rain, your subject requests to submit to the crime of lying to the throne.
proposals.reason: 麵 is a graphic slip for 面 in 面谩 (open deception before the ruler); the literal noodles reading is false.

proposals.before: Arriving at his post, the year had great invasion; he memorialized remitting nine-tenths of the tax.
proposals.after: Arriving at his post, the year had a great crop failure; he memorialized remitting nine-tenths of the tax.
proposals.reason: 歲大侵 is 大祲, a natural disaster or famine, not a military invasion; the idiomatic already renders crop failure.

proposals.before: In dress and use he did not like luxury; provision accounts and carriage surplus—even if worn he did not replace.
proposals.after: In dress and use he did not like luxury; furnishings and carriage accoutrements—even if worn he did not replace.
proposals.reason: 供帳車剩 is unintelligible; 供帳車服 (furnishings, carriages, and clothing) matches the idiomatic carriage and equipment.

proposals.before: Earlier, when Mi was at court, Vice Director Ding Huang was sent as envoy to the Jin. Mi sighed and said, "Our hereditary enemy is not yet avenged. How can we act cordially?"
proposals.after: Earlier, when Mi was at court, Vice Director Ding Yu was sent as envoy to the Jin. Mi sighed and said, "Our hereditary enemy is not yet avenged. How can we act cordially?"
proposals.reason: 焴 is Yu, not Huang; the English personal name should match 丁焴.

proposals.before: Vice Pacification Commissioner along the Yangzi Li Fu recruited him to his staff. When troops in western Huai rebelled, Li sent Ting to summon and instruct them.
proposals.after: Vice Pacification Commissioner along the Yangzi Li Zhi recruited him to his staff. When troops in western Huai rebelled, Li sent Ting to summon and instruct them.
proposals.reason: 李埴 is Li Zhi; Fu is not the reading of 埴.

proposals.before: When northern troops reached Fuguang, its people fled in panic along the roads. Court opinion held that Ting could hold the place, and he was appointed prefect of Guangzhou while also serving as frontier overall patrol commissioner.
proposals.after: When northern troops reached Fuguang, its people fled in panic along the roads. Court opinion held that Ting could hold the place, and he was appointed prefect of Guang Prefecture while also serving as frontier overall patrol commissioner.
proposals.reason: 光州 is Guang Prefecture, not Guangzhou (廣州).

proposals.before: Braving snow he traveled by night and raced to the prefecture by forced marches. He sent out scouts, put battle equipment in order, fought a great battle at Xieling Bridge, and the people of Guangzhou were secured.
proposals.after: Braving snow he traveled by night and raced to the prefecture by forced marches. He sent out scouts, put battle equipment in order, fought a great battle at Xieling Bridge, and the people of Guang Prefecture were secured.
proposals.reason: 光人 refers to people of 光州, not Guangzhou.

proposals.before: Ting was summoned to court and soon appointed prefect of Jizhou while still governing Guangzhou.
proposals.after: Ting was summoned to court and soon appointed prefect of Jizhou while still governing Guang Prefecture.
proposals.reason: 知光州 is Guang Prefecture, not Guangzhou.

proposals.before: When 200,000 troops from the various routes were about to go recover Chuzhou, Ting led his command as a flanking support.
proposals.after: When 200,000 troops from the various routes were about to go recover Chu Prefecture, Ting led his command as a flanking support.
proposals.reason: 楚州 is Chu Prefecture; Chuzhou commonly renders 滁州.

proposals.before: Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong repeatedly recommended him. He was assigned to Shouchang Command, then transferred to Qizhou, where he built school quarters and erected shrines to loyal ministers.
proposals.after: Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong jointly recommended him. He was assigned to Shouchang Command, then transferred to Qizhou, where he built school quarters and erected shrines to loyal ministers.
proposals.reason: 交薦 means the two commissioners recommended him together, not that they recommended him repeatedly.

proposals.before: Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong repeatedly recommended him; he was assigned to Shouchang Command, changed to Qizhou, built school quarters, and set up shrines to loyal ministers.
proposals.after: Pacification Commissioners Dong Huai and Deng Yong jointly recommended him; he was assigned to Shouchang Command, changed to Qizhou, built school quarters, and set up shrines to loyal ministers.
proposals.reason: 交薦 is joint recommendation by both men, not repeated recommendation.

decisions.reason: The chapter’s 麵 is a graphic error for 面 in 面謾; Wikisource Songshi 408 reads 臣請伏面謾之罪, so the noodles rendering is false and “lying to the throne” is correct.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 若能交飭內外，一正紀綱，天且不雨，臣請伏面謾之罪。

sourceWitness.excerpt: 至官，歲大侵，奏蠲其賦十之九。
